name: Glass Lotus Temple
description: A serene temple built entirely from layered glass lotus petals, each petal catching sunrise and scattering prismatic light inside.
prompt: Temple complex composed of hundreds of translucent glass lotus petals forming walls, roof, and columns. Early morning light passes through, casting rainbow caustics on a polished stone floor. Reflective pool surrounds. Hyper‑realistic, 8k, peaceful atmosphere.
caption: Where architecture blooms in light. 🌸🔮 #GlassLotusTemple
